description: Set the brand's business type — what it sells, used for structured data (schema.org) on its pages. Saved as the user's choice and never overwritten by auto-detection. Pass `kind` (software, product, local_business = customers visit a location, service = delivered by people, none) and optionally a specific `schemaType` valid for that kind (e.g. HairSalon, Dentist, Restaurant for local_business; ProfessionalService, LegalService for service; WebApplication for software); omit it for the kind's default. An unknown schemaType is rejected with the allowed list. Or pass reset: true (alone) to drop the saved choice and re-detect from the site.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

kind.description: What the business sells. Required unless reset is true.

reset.description: true = drop the saved choice and auto-detect again. Send alone, without kind/schemaType/applicationCategory.

schemaType.description: Specific schema.org subtype for the kind, e.g. HairSalon (local_business), LegalService (service), WebApplication (software). Omit for the kind's default.

name: set_business_type
